newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Plane crashes on bingo crowd in Brazil, kills eight.
newsitem.headline: Plane crashes on bingo crowd in Brazil, kills eight.

text.p: A small plane crashed in a crowded square in southeastern Brazil on Sunday, killing at least eight people and injuring dozens, police said.
The single-engined plane hit a truck and a car, then ploughed into 700 people gathered for an outdoor bingo game.
The planes's two flyers, who were taking photographs of the bingo event, survived the crash with injuries, a police spokesman said.
The accident occurred in the city of Conselheiro Lafaiete, 60 miles (96 kms) south of Belo Horizonte, in the state of Minas Gerais.
Three of the injured were in critical condition.
The police spokesman said the cause of the crash was not yet known.
The accident came four days after an explosion blew a hole in the fuselage of a commercial airliner flying over Sao Paulo state. A passenger was sucked from the aircraft and fell to his death.
